The tokens are integers, and I need to convert them into their human-readable names using the token.tok_name dictionary.

For the human_readable list, I need to loop through each token in the input list. If the token is a key in token.tok_name, I append the corresponding string. If not, I append '<unknown>'. That makes sense because some tokens might not have a defined name in the tok_name dictionary.

Next, I need to count the terminal tokens. Terminal tokens are those for which token.ISTERMINAL returns True. So, for each token, I check this condition and increment the terminal_count if it's true.

Similarly, non-terminal tokens are identified by token.ISNONTERMINAL. I'll check each token against this and increment non_terminal_count accordingly.

Lastly, I need to check if the token is the end-of-file marker using token.ISEOF. If any token in the list is token.ENDMARKER, I set contains_eof to True.
